verdict.rationale: The SDK lets developers build agents that pull in user data and analyze it. Agents can query databases through MCP or custom in-process tools, run parallel analyses with subagents, and return results as validated structured JSON. A finance-agent use case shows evaluating a user's portfolio. These insights are not a built-in product feature, though: the developer must assemble the data connections, prompts and UI themselves. Missing for 10: an out-of-the-box insights or suggestions experience over user data, a documented end-to-end data-analysis example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
